mil3.2.6:1.6: Na kho mahārāja imaṃ yeva nāmarūpaṃ paṭisandahati, iminā pana mahārāja nāmarūpena kammaṃ karoti sobhanaṃ vā pāpakaṃ vā, tena kammena aññaṃ nāmarūpaṃ paṭi- sandahatī ti. -
mil3.2.6:1.7: Yadi bhante na imaṃ yeva nāmarūpaṃ paṭisandahati nanu so mutto bhavissati pāpakehi kammehīti. -
mil3.2.6:1.9: Yadi na paṭisandaheyya mutto bhaveyya pāpakehi kammehi,
mil3.2.6:1.10: yasmā ca kho mahārāja paṭisandahati tasmā na mutto pāpakehi kammehīti.
mil3.2.6:2.2: Yathā mahārāja kocid-eva puriso aññatarassa purisassa ambaṃ avahareyya, tam-enaṃ ambasāmiko gahetvā rañño dasseyya: iminā deva purisena mayhaṃ ambā avahaṭā ti, so evaṃ vadeyya: nāhaṃ deva imassa ambe avaharāmi; aññe te ambā ye iminā ropitā, aññe te ambā ye mayā avahaṭā, nāhaṃ daṇḍappatto ti,
mil3.2.6:2.3: kin-nu kho so mahārāja puriso daṇḍappatto bhaveyyāti. -
mil3.2.6:2.6: Kiñcāpi so evaṃ vadeyya, purimaṃ bhante ambaṃ apaccakkhāya pacchimena ambena so puriso daṇḍappatto bhaveyyāti.-Evam-
mil3.2.6:2.7: eva kho mahārāja iminā nāmarūpena kammaṃ karoti sobhanaṃ vā pāpakaṃ vā, tena kammena aññaṃ nāmarūpaṃ paṭisandahati, tasmā na mutto pāpakehi kammehīti. -
mil3.2.6:3.2: Yathā mahārāja koci puriso aññatarassa purisassa sāliṃ avahareyya-pe-
mil3.2.6:3.4: yathā mahārāja koci puriso hemantike kāle aggiṃ jaletvā visīvetvā avijjhāpetvā pakkameyya, atha kho so aggi aññatarassa purisassa khettaṃ ḍaheyya, tam-enaṃ khettasāmiko gahetvā rañño dasseyya: iminā deva purisena mayhaṃ khettaṃ daḍḍhan-ti,
mil3.2.6:3.5: so evaṃ vadeyya: nāhaṃ devā imassa khettaṃ jhāpemi, añño so aggi yo mayā avijjhāpito, añño so aggi yen' imassa khettaṃ daḍḍhaṃ, nāhaṃ daṇḍappatto ti,
mil3.2.6:3.6: kin-nu kho so mahārāja puriso daṇḍappatto bhaveyyāti. -
mil3.2.6:3.9: Kiñcāpi se evaṃ vadeyya, purimaṃ bhante aggiṃ apaccakkhāya pacchimena agginā so puriso daṇḍappatto bhaveyyāti.
mil3.2.6:3.10: Evam eva kho mahārāja iminā nāmarūpena kammaṃ karoti sobhanaṃ vā pāpakaṃ vā, tena kammena aññaṃ nāmarūpaṃ paṭisandahati, tasmā na mutto pāpakehi kammehīti. -
mil3.2.6:4.2: Yathā mahārāja kocid-eva puriso padīpaṃ ādāya māḷaṃ abhirūhitvā bhuñjeyya, padīpo jhāyamāno tiṇaṃ jhāpeyya, tiṇaṃ jhāyamānaṃ gharaṃ jhāpeyya, gharaṃ jhāyamānaṃ gāmaṃ jhāpeyya, gāmajano taṃ purisaṃ gahetvā evaṃ vadeyya: kissa tvaṃ bho purisa gāmaṃ jhāpesīti, so evaṃ vadeyya: nāhaṃ bho gāmaṃ jhāpemi, añño so padīpaggi yassāhaṃ ālokena bhuñjiṃ, añño so aggi yena gāmo jhāpito ti; te vivadamānā tava santike āgaccheyyuṃ, kassa tvaṃ mahārāja atthaṃ dhāreyyāsīti. -
mil3.2.6:4.5: Kiñcāpi so evaṃ vadeyya, api ca tato eva so aggi nibbatto ti. -
mil3.2.6:4.6: Evam-eva kho mahārāja kiñcāpi aññaṃ māraṇantikaṃ nāmarūpaṃ aññaṃ paṭisandhismiṃ nāmarūpaṃ, api ca tato yeva taṃ nibbattaṃ, tasmā na mutto pāpakehi kammehīti. -
mil3.2.6:5.2: Yathā mahārāja kocid-eva puriso dahariṃ dārikaṃ vāretvā sunkaṃ datvā pakkameyya,
mil3.2.6:5.3: sā aparena samayena mahatī assa vavappattā, tato añño puriso sunkaṃ datvā vivāhaṃ kareyya, itaro āgantvā evaṃ vadeyya: kissa pana me tvaṃ ambho purisa bhariyaṃ nesīti,
mil3.2.6:5.4: so evaṃ vadeyya: nāhaṃ tava bhariyaṃ nemi, aññā sā dārikā daharī taruṇī ya tayā vāritā ca dinnasunkā ca, aññā 'yaṃ dārikā mahatī vayappattā mayā vāritā ca dinnasunkā cāti; te vivadamānā tava santike āgaccheyyuṃ,
mil3.2.6:5.8: Kiñcāpi so evaṃ vadeyya, api ca tato yeva sā mahatī nibbattā ti.
mil3.2.6:5.9: -Evam-eva kho mahārāja kiñcāpi aññaṃ māraṇantikaṃ nāmarūpaṃ aññaṃ paṭisandhismiṃ nāmarūpaṃ, api ca tato yeva taṃ nibbattaṃ, tasmā na parimutto pāpakehi kammehīti. -
mil3.2.6:6.2: Yathā mahārāja kocid-eva puriso gopālakassa hatthato khīraghaṭaṃ kiṇitvā tass' eva hatthe nikkhipitvā pakkameyya: sve gahetvā gamissāmīti, taṃ aparajju dadhi sampajjeyya,
mil3.2.6:6.3: so āgantvā evaṃ vadeyya: dehi me khīraghaṭan-ti,
mil3.2.6:6.5: itaro evaṃ vadeyya: nāhaṃ tava hatthato dadhiṃ kiṇāmi, dehi me khīraghaṭan-ti,
mil3.2.6:6.6: so evaṃ vadeyya: ajānato te khīraṃ dadhi bhūtan-ti; te vivadamānā tava santike āgaccheyyuṃ, kassa tvaṃ mahārāja atthaṃ dhāreyyāsīti. -
mil3.2.6:6.9: Kiñcāpi so evaṃ vadeyya, api ca tato yeva taṃ nibbattan-ti. -
mil3.2.6:6.10: Evam-eva kho mahārāja kiñcāpi aññaṃ māraṇantikaṃ nāmarūpaṃ aññaṃ paṭisandhismiṃ nāmarūpaṃ, api ca tato yeva taṃ nibbattaṃ, tasmā na parimutto pāpakehi kammehīti. -
